name: Cubelles (Spain)
description: Divided horizontally into two equal parts, the upper dark green with the yellow castle of the arms with red openings, the lower with four red pales on yellow.
history: The flag was approved on 22 December 1999 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3057 of 17 January 2000; it is based on the municipal arms, an oblong flag of 2:3 divided horizontally into two equal parts, the upper dark green with the yellow castle closed in red at the centre and the lower with the four bars.

features.role: closed castle with red openings, 8/18 of the height
four red pales on yellow in the lower half
